labels.googleCalendarPanelCloseHint: Right-click to close - search is remembered
labels.googleCalendarConnectAccountHint: Connect your Google account under External Accounts to load your calendar list.
labels.googleCalendarListFailedHint: Could not load your Google calendars. Only the primary calendar is available.
labels.googleCalendarCreateNewHelp: Only the middle part is editable. Prefix and suffix come from Administration → Integrations → Google and are applied automatically.
labels.googleCalendarCreateNewNameRequired: Enter a middle name for the new calendar.
labels.googleCalendarNamePrefixLocked: Prefix is set by an administrator and cannot be changed here.
labels.googleCalendarNameSuffixLocked: Suffix is set by an administrator and cannot be changed here.

messages.googleCalendarIntegrationDisabled: Google Calendar integration is disabled. Turn it on under Administration → Integrations, or uncheck Save in Google Calendar.
